<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Fire Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2987)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Although arguably quite friendly, fire scamps are considered far more dangerous than their kin. They delight in fire and playing pranks on everyone they befriend. Even given time to understand others' dislike of fire, most fire scamps enjoy the feel of flames enough to constantly test their limits. Compared to the nations of other scamps, the nations on the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=31) are by far the strongest. This backing inspires fire scamps to challenge authority more quickly than the others.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Elemental](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=43)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Fire_Scamp.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Fire Scamp](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2987)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Small" />
<trait label="Elemental" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=587" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=604" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 147

**Perception** +3; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), smoke vision

**Languages**
[Pyric](/Languages.aspx?ID=110)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +7, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +7

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +0

**Dex** +4

**Con** +0

**Int** -2

**Wis** +0

**Cha** +2
</row>

**Smoke Vision** The fire scamp ignores the [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) condition from smoke.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +3 

**Ref** +9 

**Will** +7 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 16
([fast healing 2](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=62) (while touching fire))

</row>

**Immunities**
bleed, [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669), [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696)

**Weaknesses**
[cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555) 3

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet, fly 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +9 ([Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179)),
**Damage** 1d6 piercing and 1d4 fire

**Arcane Innate Spells** DC 15
- **Cantrips (1st)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Ignition](/Spells.aspx?ID=1565), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171)

**Flame Breath** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72)) The fire scamp breathes flames in a 15- foot cone that deals 2d4 fire damage to each creature within the area (DC 17 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures that fail the save also take 1d4 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). The fire scamp can't use Flame Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

</column>
